meta.title: Nord-Ouest Department - Haiti
meta.description: Learn about the Nord-Ouest department of Haiti, its 10 communes, and the Senate race.

intro.paragraph1: Nord-Ouest is one of Haiti's ten departments, with its capital in Port-de-Paix. The department is organized into three arrondissements (Môle-Saint-Nicolas, Port-de-Paix, and Saint-Louis-du-Nord) and ten communes.
intro.paragraph2: The estimated 2015 population was 728,807 according to IHSI data. Each commune has its own character and contributes to the department's identity.
